system.description:
ESHARI

You have performed enough funerals to know that haste need not mean disrespect.
You may Perform Last Rites in 1 minute rather than 10 minutes. When you do so, improve the protection provided by the action:
Critical Protection lasts 1 month.
Success Protection lasts 7 days.
Partial Protection lasts 24 hours.
All other rules for Perform Last Rites remain unchanged.

Prerequisites Level 10, Religion 3 ranks

Works automatically: Perform Last Rites takes 1 minute and its card prints the longer protections (1 month / 7 days / 24 hours).
